end.summary:
- Practised top/bottom and on/under using object-position examples.
- Shaurya gave 4/4 unaided answers for top/bottom and on/under.
- Practised inside/outside and near/far with a crease, ball, matka, and cat.
- Left/right and in-front/behind were discussed as depending on which way a person faces; the mix-up was corrected after the last observed error.
- Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised position words through concrete examples and asked Shaurya to describe where objects were. They used top/bottom and on/under accurately across the examples. Left/right was mixed up when the facing direction changed, but this was corrected later in the lesson. At home, place two toys in different positions and ask, “Which is near/far, inside/outside, left/right?” while turning the toy person around.
